name: Starlight Vials
summary: Starlight Vials is a quiet pouring puzzle. The player taps two glass vials and pours matching colors together. Each vial holds four layers. Liquid can be poured only into an empty vial or onto the same color on top. The game includes two hundred levels and a daily trial that changes with the date. Pour count awards one to three stars. Undo is always available. No account is required. Lessons and levels can be played offline. The Google Play listing discloses ads and in-app purchases.
